scope: Opt-in deploy/identity only; not config-register.active or a production phase switch

inputs.name: IDENTITY_STATE_DIR
inputs.validation: Absolute existing local directory containing operator-owned files; never a build context

inputs.name: IDENTITY_PROXY_NETWORK
inputs.validation: Existing dedicated internal Docker bridge; do not reuse unrelated networks

inputs.name: IDENTITY_PROXY_IP
inputs.validation: Available IPv4 on that bridge, assigned only to gateway; backend trusts this exact /32

inputs.name: IDENTITY_HTTPS_HOST
inputs.validation: DNS hostname matching certificate SAN and trusted origin; no port or Nginx syntax

inputs.name: IDENTITY_HTTPS_PORT
inputs.validation: Host loopback port 1..65535; verifier alone may use 0 for Docker allocated port

state_files.root-password: MySQL root secret, read through MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD_FILE; not an application environment key
state_files.initialize.sql: First-volume database/user provisioning, dedicated DML and DDL accounts REQUIRE SSL; operator supplies values locally
state_files.server.key: MySQL private key, copied to tmpfs mysql ownership mode 0400
state_files.backend.env: MYSQL_DSN, MYSQL_CA_FILE, AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGIN only; proxy /32 supplied by Compose
state_files.admin.env: MYSQL_DSN, MYSQL_MIGRATION_DSN, MYSQL_CA_FILE; never mounted in backend
